notes.title: Kernel v0.7.14 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where dice could ignore space limits and swap with units in the preparation area.
New Features and Improvements

Optimized the behavior logic of [Ability: Kite].
Added a new Patch System.
Improved the card selection panel.
Added items: [Shuffler], [Emergency Autocannon], [Delayed-Explosion Charge], [Beast Tonic], [Reflective Wall] (release version content).
Improved visual effects for item triggers.
Added characters: [Nachar – Red Peak Overlord], [Little Bones], [Hundred-Eyed Demon], [Myriad-Eyed Demon], [Soul-Eating Brain] (release version content).
Optimized several sound effects.
Other Changes

Adjusted the difficulty curve of enemy lineups in the Fluorescent-Green Astral Realm.

notes.title: Kernel v0.7.0 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. New Features & Improvements

   * Added new traits: **\[Dice]**, **\[Key of Fate]**, **\[Parting Gift]**, **\[Dice Cannon]**, **\[Root Nodule]**, **\[Vital Infusion]**, **\[My Bald Buddy]**, **\[My Robot Buddy]**, **\[Universal Core]**
   * Added new skills: **Stone Shockburst**, **Greatvine Vortex**, **Radish Fistwave**
   * Added new characters: **Dice**, **Azure Treant**, **Carrot**, **Prototype**
   * Optimized card hand interaction logic
   * Added dynamic difficulty display
   * Added partial skill sound effects
   * Added new player tutorials
   * Added card upgrade preview feature
   * Added booster pack **\[Sacred Grove]**
   * Added portal detail view functionality
   * Added card pool viewing feature
   * The "Unstable Portal" event now displays the cards received
   * Improved map logic: the starting node is now always connected in three directions

2. Visual Adjustments

   * Replaced some UI assets
   * Updated some card illustrations
   * Enhanced visuals for the start screen
   * Improved particle effects for certain skills
   * Improved visual effects for some cards

3. Bug Fixes

   * Fixed an issue where some cards appeared incorrectly in the shop
   * Fixed a bug causing duplicate rewards
   * Fixed various known bugs

4. Other Adjustments

   * Adjusted the effects of certain skills
   * Tweaked rarity levels of some units
   * Adjusted unit stats
   * Revised level display logic: the minimum level is now one star

notes.title: Kernel v0.5.13 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Bug Fixes
   - Fixed some card skill display issues
   - Fixed some tutorial interface bugs

2. New Features & Optimizations
   - Removed the [Deck Core] mechanism, now allowing fully custom deck building
   - Removed the card recycling from graveyard when draw pile is empty

3. Card Changes
   - Modified [Small Shield] effect: Now grants 25 Armor to all allied units on the battlefield
   - Changed [Graveside Fishing] cost to 1
   - Modified [Gluttony] to draw 5 cards
   - Changed [Instant Discount] cost to 0
   - Modified [Space Loan] cost to 1
   - Updated [Purification] to cost 3, with new effect: Removes all negative statuses from allied units on the battlefield
   - Revised [Toxic Agent] effect: Applies 10 stacks of Poison to all enemy units
   - Modified [Toxic Outburst] effect: Deals damage equal to [Poison] stacks × 5 to all enemy units

notes.title: Kernel v0.5.9 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Bug Fixes
   - Fixed a bug where units couldn't be summoned in the final round of the portal

notes.title: Kernel v0.5.8 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Bug Fixes
   - Fixed issue where card removal interface couldn't be closed
   - Resolved potential bug causing builds to be in test mode
   - Corrected card flip animation bug during card draw

2. Gameplay Adjustments
   - Standardized all unit space occupation to 1
   - Modified supply station reward system: basic supply rewards now appear at fixed levels

3. New Features & Optimizations
   - Added card refresh function in shops: players can now spend 25 gold to refresh card offerings

4. Visual Improvements
   - Added background to HP and Armor values

notes.title: Kernel v0.5.7 Update Notes

   - Resolved Discord address bug
   - Corrected logic errors in ranged skills

2. Visual Improvements
   - Updated card draw animation to feature card flipping
   - Optimized UI for regional card details

notes.title: Kernel v0.5.6 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Visual Adjustments
   - Reduced unit outline width
   - Adjusted chromatic aberration effect during Time Rift - the effect now appears and then disappears when activating Time Rift
   - Modified animation speed for the [Burning Earth] skill
   - Adjusted UI layout for card zone icons

2. New Features
   - Added world map zoom functionality
   - Implemented speed-up feature
   - Added confirmation prompts for returning to main menu and quitting game
   - Introduced "Void Corruption" anti-stalemate mechanism: after a prolonged stalemate, the battlefield enters "Void Corruption" state, where all units continuously take increasing damage
